module_summary: Two-state JK-style Moore FSM with asynchronous reset: j turns it on, k turns it off, out decodes the ON state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Single-bit OFF/ON state register updated from j and k.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Decoded from ON state; module's only output.

groups.name: onoff_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on j/k toggles state; out reflects ON.
